title: Scintillator-Based Event-Mode Neutron Imaging with Timepix4 Readout
abstract: Scintillator-based event-mode neutron imaging is emerging as a powerful approach to neutron radiography. Unlike conventional integrating-mode neutron imaging, which accumulates scintillation light during an exposure, event reconstruction estimates neutron-event positions and arrival times from time-stamped optical responses. We investigated this approach using a self-developed Timepix4-based optical readout system, image-formation analysis, and beam experiments at the China Spallation Neutron Source under different scintillator and optical configurations. The analysis explains how event localization can reduce image blur associated with the spatial extent of individual scintillation responses. Under the same 0.35$\times$ optical configuration, event reconstruction improved the spatial resolution from 164.2 to 91.9 $\mu$m at 10% modulation transfer function (MTF), while a 2.1$\times$ configuration with a $\mathrm{Gd_2O_2S:Tb}$ scintillator achieved 26.1 $\mu$m at the same MTF threshold. Following event reconstruction and rejection of single-photon reconstructed events, the mean peak-normalized spectral response in the 6-8 angstrom out-of-band interval decreased by 85.4% relative to the raw-pixel wavelength-count spectrum, indicating reduced afterglow-related spectral background. Under the tested pulsed-beam conditions, the maximum instantaneous pixel-hit rate per pixel was approximately four times its time-averaged value, providing an experimental basis for assessing readout requirements at higher neutron flux. Conventional radiography resolved structural details, while energy-selective imaging enhanced the contrast between materials with similar broadband transmission and Bragg-edge imaging revealed crystallographic features in steel. These results demonstrate the imaging-quality benefits and capabilities of scintillator-based event-mode neutron imaging.

summaries.en: Using a Timepix4-based optical readout with event reconstruction, the authors improved scintillator-based neutron imaging spatial resolution from 164.
summaries.zh: 作者利用基于Timepix4的光学读出与事件重建，将闪烁体中子成像在10% MTF下的空间分辨率从164.
summaries.ja: 著者らはTimepix4ベースの光学読み出しとイベント再構成を用いることで、シンチレータ中性子イメージングの10% MTFにおける空間分解能を164.

title: Cavity Control of Emission Dynamics from Spin Defects in Hexagonal Boron Nitride
abstract: Optically addressable negatively charged boron vacancy ($\mathrm{V_B^-}$) defects in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) are promising for quantum sensing at room temperature. The two-dimensional structure of hBN allows direct access to the local environment, enabling proximal sensing of target materials. However, its broadband emission and low quantum yield hinder efficient light-matter interaction, and the coupling of $\mathrm{V_B^-}$ optical dipoles to confined cavity fields remains poorly understood. In this study, we integrate $\mathrm{V_B^-}$ defects with a tunable plano-concave microcavity, achieving three-dimensional optical confinement. This approach yields photoluminescence (PL) enhancement and cavity-modified optical decay dynamics, providing insights into the orientation of the $\mathrm{V_B^-}$ defect dipole. Time-resolved PL measurements identify a distinct fast decay component, suggesting a complex dipole geometry for the defects. Therefore, a tilted optical dipole model is considered to attribute the fast and slow decay components to in-plane and out-of-plane dipole contributions, respectively. Additionally, optically detected magnetic resonance and excitation-polarisation-dependent PL measurements provide further insights into local symmetry breaking and potential optical dipole configurations. These results highlight the role of optical dipole orientation in $\mathrm{V_B^-}$ defect-cavity coupling.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci)

summaries.en: Integrating negatively charged boron vacancy defects in hexagonal boron nitride with a tunable plano-concave microcavity yields photoluminescence enhancement and cavity-modified decay dynamics, with a tilted optical dipole model attributing fast and slow decay components to in-plane and out-of-plane dipole contributions and revealing the role of dipole orientation in defect-cavity coupling.
summaries.zh: 将六方氮化硼中的负电荷硼空位缺陷与可调谐平凹微腔集成，实现了光致发光增强和腔修饰的衰减动力学，并通过倾斜光学偶极模型将快、慢衰减分量分别归因于面内和面外偶极贡献，揭示了偶极取向在缺陷-腔耦合中的作用。
summaries.ja: 六方窒化ホウ素中の負電荷ホウ素空孔欠陥を調整可能な平凹微小共振器と集積することで、フォトルミネッセンスの増強と共振器による減衰ダイナミクスの変調が得られ、傾いた光学双極子モデルにより速い減衰成分と遅い減衰成分をそれぞれ面内および面外双極子の寄与に帰属させ、欠陥と共振器の結合における双極子配向の役割を明らかにした。

title: Experimental observation of higher-harmonic generation of whistler waves in magnetized plasma of Large Volume Plasma Device
abstract: We report the higher-harmonic generation of whistler waves using a loop antenna in the Large Volume Plasma Device (LVPD). The antenna is energized using a pulse-forming network (PFN), and the excited magnetic fluctuations are measured using a three-axis B-dot probe. Experiments are performed in a moderate-density ($n_e \sim 1-2 \times 10^{17}\ \text{m}^{-3}$), low-temperature ($T_e \sim 2-5\ \text{eV}$) argon plasma in a uniform axial magnetic field ($B_z \sim 6.2\ \text{G}$). A Helmholtz coil is employed to investigate the dependence of the wave response and propagation on the local magnetic-field configuration. A clear distinction between wave characteristics is observed in the absence and presence of plasma: in plasma, the excited wave shows a significant $\delta B_y$ component along with $\delta B_x$, indicating polarization. In addition to the fundamental frequency, distinct spectral peaks are observed at $300\ \text{kHz}$, $450\ \text{kHz}$, and $600\ \text{kHz}$. These harmonics indicate nonlinear wave-plasma interactions, and bicoherence analysis further provides evidence of nonlinear coupling between the observed frequency components. The spatial propagation of the wave was systematically diagnosed using a linear array of five identical B-dot probes. Spatial cross-correlation analysis reveals strong structural coherence during wave propagation, allowing the explicit experimental determination of the wave phase velocity ($V_{ph}$) and parallel wave number ($k_{\parallel}$) for the generated higher harmonics. The measured propagation is oblique at an angle of approximately $48^\circ$ with respect to the background magnetic field, and the experimental dispersion relation agrees with the cold-plasma oblique whistler dispersion relation within experimental uncertainty.

summaries.en: The paper reports experimental observation of higher-harmonic generation (300, 450, and 600 kHz) of whistler waves excited by a loop antenna in the Large Volume Plasma Device, with bicoherence analysis confirming nonlinear wave coupling and measurements showing oblique propagation at about 48° to the background magnetic field consistent with the cold-plasma oblique whistler dispersion relation.
summaries.zh: 该论文报道了在大型体积等离子体装置中利用环形天线激发哨声波并实验观测到其高次谐波（300、450和600 kHz），双相干分析证实了非线性波耦合，测量表明波以约48°倾角相对背景磁场斜传播，且色散关系与冷等离子体斜哨声波色散关系一致。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、Large Volume Plasma Deviceにおいてループアンテナで励起したホイスラー波の高調波（300、450、600 kHz）の実験的観測を報告し、バイコヒーレンス解析により非線形波動結合を確認するとともに、波が背景磁場に対して約48°の斜め伝搬を示し、その分散関係が冷プラズマ斜めホイスラー分散関係と一致することを明らかにした。

title: Recovery of accidental bound states in the continuum in vertically asymmetric photonic lattices through radiation-source parity restoration
abstract: Vertical asymmetry generally precludes accidental bound states in the continuum (BICs) in planar photonic lattices, yet the underlying physical mechanism remains unclear. In this study, we show that accidental-BIC formation is governed by the definite parity of the transverse radiation-source profile rather than by geometric vertical mirror symmetry. A semianalytical coupled-mode analysis shows that an accidental BIC occurs when the radiation overlap integral of a leaky Bloch mode vanishes. We decompose the overlap into contributions from the even- and odd-parity components of the transverse radiation-source profile. Complete radiation suppression requires both contributions to vanish simultaneously. In vertically symmetric lattices, the source profile has definite even or odd parity, causing one contribution to vanish identically. Thickness tuning can null the remaining contribution and produce an accidental BIC. In vertically asymmetric lattices, by contrast, both parity components are generally present. The waveguide dispersion forbids their simultaneous vanishing, thereby precluding an accidental BIC. Introducing a parity-restoring layer into a vertically asymmetric lattice restores definite parity to the transverse radiation-source profile, thereby enabling the formation of an accidental BIC. Finite-element simulations confirm the analytically predicted recovery of accidental BICs for both TE$_0$ and TE$_1$ Bloch modes.

summaries.en: Accidental bound states in the continuum in planar photonic lattices are governed by the definite parity of the transverse radiation-source profile rather than vertical mirror symmetry, so a parity-restoring layer added to a vertically asymmetric lattice can restore that parity and recover accidental BICs for both TE0 and TE1 Bloch modes.
summaries.zh: 平面光子晶格中的偶然连续域束缚态由横向辐射源分布的确定宇称而非垂直镜像对称决定，因此在垂直非对称晶格中引入宇称恢复层可恢复该宇称，从而为TE0和TE1布洛赫模实现偶然连续域束缚态的恢复。
summaries.ja: 平面フォトニック格子における偶発的連続域束縛状態は垂直鏡映対称性ではなく横方向放射源プロファイルの確定したパリティによって支配されるため、垂直非対称格子にパリティ回復層を導入するとそのパリティが回復し、TE0およびTE1ブロッホモードの偶発的連続域束縛状態が再現される。

title: Intrinsic Berry Curvature on the Higher-order Poincare Sphere
abstract: Higer-order geometric phase enable versatile spin-orbit manipulation of structured light . Con ventional theories describe this phase via a total-angular-momentum dependent Berry curvature . We develop an intrinsic theory restricted to the effective two-dimensional subspace, where the Berry curvature is independent of the topological charge of the light field . In our framework, the total-angular-momentum difference does not alter the effective monopole strength, whereas it controls the solid angle enclosed by the trajectory of the state evolution, insteadly. Our theory provides a different topological interpretation of geometric phase of the structured light, which unifies the underlying structures of generalized Poincare Spheres. Furthermore, it does not impose any specific form on the physical operation of the optical element, naturally encomoassing the case of previously reported experiment, and can be applied in arbitrary state evolutions in both classical structured light and quantum spin-orbit systems .

summaries.en: The paper develops an intrinsic Berry-curvature theory restricted to the effective two-dimensional subspace of structured light, showing that the Berry curvature is independent of the field's topological charge and that the total-angular-momentum difference controls the enclosed solid angle rather than the effective monopole strength, thereby unifying the geometry of generalized higher-order Poincaré spheres and applying to arbitrary state evolutions in classical structured light and quantum spin-orbit systems.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种限制于有效二维子空间的内禀Berry曲率理论，表明Berry曲率与光场的拓扑电荷无关，而总角动量差并不改变有效单极子强度、而是控制态演化轨迹所包围的立体角，从而统一了广义高阶庞加莱球的底层结构，并可应用于经典结构光与量子自旋-轨道系统中的任意态演化。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、有効な二次元部分空間に制限した内在的Berry曲率の理論を構築し、Berry曲率が光場のトポロジカル電荷に依存しないこと、全角運動量の差は有効単極子強度を変えずに状態発展の軌跡が囲む立体角を制御することを示すことで、一般化された高次ポアンカレ球の背後にある構造を統一的に扱い、古典構造光および量子スピン軌道系における任意の状態発展に適用できることを示した。

title: Laser Processing for Energy Applications
abstract: Laser processing has emerged as a transformative technology in the energy sector, enabling precise, efficient, and scalable solutions for energy generation, storage, and sustainability. This chapter explores the diverse applications of laser technology in energy applications. It begins with an overview of laser-driven inertial confinement fusion for energy production, highlighting key experimental facilities and crucial laser parameters. The role of lasers in solar energy harvesting is examined, including photovoltaic cell optimization, concentrated solar power, and laser-assisted recycling of solar modules. The chapter further reviews recent developments into laser-based techniques for enhancing electrochemical performance through surface texturing at various scales. Advancements in lithium-ion battery technology are also discussed, focusing on next-generation materials, battery manufacturing processes, and the impact of laser techniques on performance, safety, and scalability. The chapter concludes with insights into future prospects for laser applications in sustainable energy solutions.

summaries.en: This chapter reviews laser processing technologies for energy applications, covering laser-driven inertial confinement fusion, solar energy harvesting including photovoltaic optimization and module recycling, laser surface texturing for enhanced electrochemical performance, and advances in lithium-ion battery materials and manufacturing.
summaries.zh: 本章综述了激光加工技术在能源领域的应用，涵盖激光驱动惯性约束聚变、包括光伏优化与组件回收在内的太阳能利用、用于提升电化学性能的激光表面织构化，以及锂离子电池材料与制造方面的进展。
summaries.ja: 本章では、レーザー駆動慣性閉じ込め核融合、太陽光発電セルの最適化やモジュールリサイクルを含む太陽エネルギー利用、電気化学性能向上のためのレーザー表面テクスチャリング、リチウムイオン電池の材料と製造の進展など、エネルギー応用に向けたレーザー加工技術を概説する。

title: Subwavelength confinement of optical and acoustic waves for enhancing Brillouin gain in a planar waveguide structure
abstract: We propose a planar waveguide structure consisting of two layers separated by a gap that provides subwavelength confinement of optical and acoustic modes and a large overlap integral between them. This, in turn, leads to an increase in Brillouin gain. Using the structure of two Si$_3$N$_4$ layers with a subwavelength gap from SiO$_2$ as an example, we demonstrate that a hybridized transverse-magnetic (TM) optical mode exhibits strong field confinement in the SiO$_2$ gap. Simultaneously, a high-frequency acoustic mode can be confined in the same gap, providing a high spatial overlap between the optical and acoustic fields. This provides a high opto-acoustic interaction with a Brillouin gain up to $5$ W$^{-1}$m$^{-1}$. The proposed structure is compatible with planar photonic integration and offers a promising platform for compact, low-threshold Brillouin lasers and coherent phonon generation.

summaries.en: A planar waveguide with two Si3N4 layers separated by a subwavelength SiO2 gap confines both a hybridized TM optical mode and a high-frequency acoustic mode in the gap, yielding a large opto-acoustic overlap and a Brillouin gain up to 5 W^-1 m^-1.
summaries.zh: 一种由被亚波长SiO2间隙分隔的两层Si3N4构成的平面波导结构，可将杂化TM光模和高频声模同时限制在该间隙中，从而实现大的光声重叠和高达5 W^-1 m^-1的布里渊增益。
summaries.ja: サブ波長のSiO2ギャップで隔てられた2層のSi3N4からなる平面導波路構造において、ハイブリッド化したTM光モードと高周波音響モードを同一ギャップに閉じ込めることで、光と音響の大きな空間重なりと最大5 W^-1 m^-1のブリルアン利得が得られる。

title: Compact Dielectric Barrier Discharge Source for a Pulsed Supersonic Beam of Metastable Triplet H$_2$
abstract: We present a compact dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) source for producing pulsed supersonic beams of metastable molecules, designed to mount directly onto existing gas valves without modification. Unlike plate or corona discharge sources, the DBD produces no static electric field in the expansion zone and relies on capacitively coupled microdischarges that are inherently self-limiting. Charge accumulation on the dielectric terminates each event within nanoseconds and locally suppresses re-ignition, so that successive microdischarges are distributed across the nozzle. Arc formation and the associated hot spots are thereby prevented, and the gas is excited uniformly over the duration of the pulse. The source requires only a single custom ceramic nozzle and a compact printed circuit board (PCB) carrying the drive electronics, mounted directly in front of the valve. The high-voltage pulses are generated in-vacuum on the PCB from a DC supply voltage. Complete design files, circuit schematics, fabrication details, and validated simulation files are provided to allow straightforward reproduction. The DBD is applied to produce H$_2$ in the metastable c$^3\Pi_u^-$ state. This state can be used as an intermediate step for state-selective preparation of H$_2^+$ molecular ions by pulsed field ionization of optically prepared molecular Rydberg states, without requiring vacuum-ultraviolet radiation. We characterize the source by time-of-flight and Resonance-Enhanced Multiphoton Ionization (REMPI) spectroscopy, obtaining an excitation fraction on the order of $10^{-8}$ into the metastable state. The dependence of the yield on stagnation pressure and discharge voltage is consistent with collisional quenching as the dominant pressure-dependent loss.

summaries.en: A compact dielectric barrier discharge source, mountable directly on existing gas valves and generating high-voltage pulses in-vacuum on a PCB, produces pulsed supersonic beams of metastable triplet H2 with an excitation fraction of order 10^-8, as characterized by time-of-flight and REMPI spectroscopy, for use in state-selective preparation of H2+ ions without vacuum-ultraviolet radiation.
summaries.zh: 一种紧凑的介质阻挡放电光源可直接安装在现有气体阀门上，并在印刷电路板上于真空中产生高压脉冲，从而产生亚稳态三重态H2的脉冲超声束，其激发分数约为10^-8，并通过飞行时间法和共振增强多光子电离光谱进行了表征，可用于无需真空紫外辐射的H2+离子态选择性制备。
summaries.ja: 既存のガスバルブに直接取り付け可能でプリント基板上で真空中に高電圧パルスを生成する小型誘電体バリア放電源により、励起割合約10^-8の準安定三重項H2のパルス超音速ビームを生成し、飛行時間法と共鳴増強多光子イオン化分光法で評価した本手法は、真空紫外放射を必要としないH2+分子イオンの状態選択的生成に利用できる。

title: Observation of Crossover from Repulsive to Attractive Interactions between Two $nS$-Rydberg Atoms in Dual-Species Atom Arrays
abstract: Dual-species Rydberg atom arrays provide a flexible platform for engineering long-range interactions beyond the conventional isotropic blockade regime. We spectroscopically study interactions between different $s$-state Rydberg levels in a $^{87}\mathrm{Rb}$--$^{85}\mathrm{Rb}$ optical-tweezer array. By varying the principal-quantum-number difference $\Delta n$ around $61S_{1/2}$, we observe a crossover from repulsive to attractive interactions. We identify a distinct regime at $\Delta n=2$ in which Förster-enhanced electronic spin exchange dominates over orbital exchange and produces a strongly bond-orientation-dependent pair spectrum. Time-domain collective-excitation measurements reveal this geometry-dependent spin exchange through a pronounced anisotropy of the double-excitation probability. For $\Delta n=1$, by contrast, orbital exchange dominates and the interaction is nearly isotropic. These results establish the principal-quantum-number difference and bond orientation as complementary control parameters for tailoring Rydberg interaction spectra and collective excitation dynamics, opening new opportunities for engineering spin-dependent Hamiltonians in programmable atom arrays.

summaries.en: Spectroscopic measurements in a 87Rb–85Rb optical-tweezer array reveal a crossover from repulsive to attractive interactions between two nS Rydberg atoms as the principal-quantum-number difference is varied, with Förster-enhanced spin exchange dominating at Δn=2 to produce a strongly bond-orientation-dependent pair spectrum while orbital exchange dominates and yields nearly isotropic interactions at Δn=1.
summaries.zh: 在87Rb–85Rb光镊阵列中的光谱测量显示，随着主量子数差的改变，两个nS里德伯原子之间的相互作用会从排斥转变为吸引，其中在Δn=2时Förster增强的自旋交换占主导并产生强烈依赖于键取向的配对光谱，而在Δn=1时轨道交换占主导且相互作用近乎各向同性。
summaries.ja: 87Rb–85Rb光ピンセットアレイにおける分光測定により、主量子数差を変えると2つのnSリュードベリ原子間の相互作用が反発から引力へクロスオーバーし、Δn=2ではフェルスター増強されたスピン交換が支配的となって結合方向に強く依存する対スペクトルが生じる一方、Δn=1では軌道交換が支配的で相互作用はほぼ等方的であることが明らかになった。

title: Continuous superradiant lasing on a narrow optical transition
abstract: Lasers with ultrastable frequency are at the foundation of optical clocks, which enable precision tests of fundamental physics and relativistic geodesy at the centimetre scale. Such lasers inherit their frequency stability from the length stability of a sophisticated optical resonator, which is hard to maintain outside a well-controlled laboratory environment and limited by thermal and technical noise. Superradiant lasers promise to overcome these limitations by storing their coherence in the atoms making up the laser's gain medium. Superradiant lasing has been demonstrated on narrow optical atomic transitions with pulsed and quasi-continuous operation. However, atom loss has prevented truly continuous operation, which severely limits their suitability for clocks. Here we demonstrate a superradiant laser on a narrow optical transition in $^{88}$Sr that operates truly continuously. We sustain emission for more than eight hours and measure a linewidth of 320(40) Hz, more than 20 times below the natural linewidth. The emission frequency remains anchored to the atomic transition, making the laser itself an atomic frequency reference. Our results provide a route towards a laser that reaches short-term frequency stability comparable to that of the best resonator-stabilized lasers. Furthermore, truly continuous operation gives us access to physics beyond the transient regime, enabling the exploration of robust nonequilibrium steady states and sustained coherent collective dynamics.

summaries.en: Researchers demonstrated truly continuous superradiant lasing on a narrow optical transition in 88Sr for over eight hours with a 320(40) Hz linewidth, more than 20 times below the natural linewidth, with the emission frequency anchored to the atomic transition.
summaries.zh: 研究人员在88Sr的窄光学跃迁上实现了真正连续的超辐射激光，持续发射超过八小时，测得线宽为320(40) Hz，比自然线宽窄20倍以上，且发射频率锁定于原子跃迁。
summaries.ja: 研究者らは88Srの狭い光学遷移において真に連続的な超放射レーザーを実現し、8時間以上にわたり発振を維持して320(40) Hzの線幅（自然線幅の20分の1以下）を測定し、発振周波数は原子遷移に固定されることを示した。

title: Shared-State Inverse Synthesis of Dual-Mode Conformal Metasurfaces for Low Scattering and Telemetry
abstract: A conformal surface that alternates between sectoral low scattering and directive telemetry poses a shared-hardware inverse problem when both modes must use one finite passive impedance alphabet, although their spatial codebooks may differ. This paper formulates and solves that mixed continuous--discrete problem at the effective impedance-boundary level. Reference-centered Tikhonov preimages prescribe restricted radiation data; inverse-source null-space freedom then moves each current within its data-equivalent class toward impedance profiles quantizable by the same alphabet. A line-searched Gauss--Newton update, common-state assignment and projected-centroid updates, and exact forward refinement determine the currents, two codebooks, and one passive library. Data invariance, the current-to-impedance differential, the optimal state update, monotonic mismatch reduction, and a forward perturbation bound are derived. A full-mutual-coupling two-dimensional TM study of a $4\lambda_0$-diameter cylinder uses 64 physical cells and one shared eight-state library. On a 256-unknown validation model, the worst power ratio over $\pm10^{\circ}$ monostatic sectors and incidence angles from $-30^{\circ}$ to $30^{\circ}$ is $-11.6$~dB relative to a PEC cylinder; telemetry directivity is 13.1~dB with $-13.6$-dB peak sidelobes and a $1^{\circ}$ pointing error. A separate Fourier--Galerkin formulation, converged through 513 complex modes without reoptimization, gives $-11.36$~dB and 13.02~dB for the corresponding worst-sector and directivity metrics. The results establish feasibility at the effective impedance-boundary level; they do not establish unit-cell, bias-network, or platform-level realizability.

summaries.en: The paper formulates a shared-hardware inverse synthesis problem at the effective impedance-boundary level for conformal metasurfaces that alternate between sectoral low scattering and directive telemetry using a single passive impedance alphabet, and demonstrates in a full-mutual-coupling TM study of a 4λ0-diameter cylinder that worst-sector power ratios reach −11.
summaries.zh: 本文在有效阻抗边界层面提出并求解了共形超表面的共享硬件逆合成问题，使同一无源阻抗字母表下的表面可在扇区低散射与定向遥测两种模式间切换，并在4λ0直径圆柱的全互耦TM研究中实现了最差扇区功率比−11.
summaries.ja: 本論文は、単一の受動インピーダンスアルファベットを用いてセクター低散乱と指向性テレメトリを切り替える共形メタサーフェスの共有ハードウェア逆合成問題を実効インピーダンス境界レベルで定式化・求解し、直径4λ0円柱の完全相互結合TM解析において最悪セクターパワー比−11.

title: Controlling Mode-Locking in Liquid Light
abstract: Mode-locking is the process by which the phases of many cavity modes organize collectively into a stationary state. In lasers, mode-locking originates from the interplay of gain, loss, dispersion and nonlinearities, most commonly resulting in the emission of short pulses. However, pulse formation is prevented when the gain recovery is fast enough to suppress amplitude fluctuations. Mode-locking then produces an extended state of nearly constant intensity, whose dynamics is governed by the phase. Yet, a general framework for designing the phase of such extended photonic states remains lacking. Here we introduce a hydrodynamic approach to designing extended photonic states, in which the phase dynamics are understood and controlled as a flow of liquid-like light. The intensity, clamped by fast gain, plays the role of a constant density, the instantaneous frequency that of a flow velocity, and the programmable radio-frequency modulation applied to the laser acts as a potential landscape that controls the flow. We derive analytical solutions connecting the applied modulation to the instantaneous frequency and hence to the spectrum emitted by the laser. We further provide experimental evidence for the liquid light shaping framework by measuring the frequency comb spectra emitted by a fast-gain semiconductor laser around \SI{1.6}{\micro\m} under the control of a programmed modulation, and comparing them to the ones predicted by the analytical solution. The hydrodynamic picture of mode-locking provides a predictive design principle for frequency combs, pointing toward a programmable synthesizer of light, and establishes fast-gain lasers as an accessible, electrically driven platform for nonequilibrium fluids of light.

summaries.en: This paper introduces a hydrodynamic framework that treats the phase dynamics of fast-gain mode-locked lasers as a flow of liquid-like light, with intensity acting as constant density, instantaneous frequency as flow velocity, and programmable radio-frequency modulation as a potential landscape, yielding analytical solutions for the emitted frequency comb spectra that are confirmed experimentally in a semiconductor laser near 1.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种流体力学框架，将快增益锁模激光器中的相位动力学视为类液态光的流动，其中强度充当恒定密度、瞬时频率充当流速、可编程射频调制充当控制流动的势场，由此推导出的发射频率梳光谱解析解在约1.
summaries.ja: 本論文は、高速利得モード同期レーザーにおける位相ダイナミクスを液体状の光の流れとして捉える流体力学的枠組みを導入し、強度を一定密度、瞬時周波数を流速、プログラム可能な高周波変調を流れを制御するポテンシャル地形として扱うことで、発振周波数コムスペクトルの解析解を導出し、約1.

title: Windowed Singularity Subtraction for the Spectral Integral Method
abstract: In 2004, the spectral integral method (SIM) was proposed to solve TM$_z$ scattering by homogeneous two-dimensional dielectric objects and perfect electrical conductors with smooth boundaries. Its error decreases exponentially as the number of boundary points increases linearly. Plasmonic resonances, however, require TE$_z$ polarization and permittivities with a negative real part. The extension of SIM to this case shows that the original global singularity subtraction suffers catastrophic cancellation, with a round-off floor that grows exponentially with the attenuation accumulated across the object. To resolve this issue, this work introduces a windowed singularity subtraction that limits this cancellation amplification to an exponential factor that the user can set independently of the object size, provided the window is adequately resolved. Numerical results verify the accuracy of the proposed method.

summaries.en: A windowed singularity subtraction is introduced for the spectral integral method to eliminate the catastrophic cancellation that occurs for TEz plasmonic scattering, limiting cancellation amplification to a user-set exponential factor independent of object size as long as the window is adequately resolved.
summaries.zh: 针对谱积分方法提出了一种加窗奇异性减除技术，以消除TEz等离激元散射中出现的灾难性相消，在窗口充分分辨的前提下，将相消放大限制为由用户设定、与物体尺寸无关的指数因子。
summaries.ja: スペクトル積分法に対し窓付き特異性減算を導入し、TEzプラズモン散乱で生じる壊滅的な相殺を解消するとともに、窓が十分に分解されている限り、相殺の増幅を物体サイズに依存せずユーザーが設定できる指数因子に抑える。

title: A spherical body in plasma simulated with adaptive mesh and algorithm refinement
abstract: An absorbing sphere in a weakly ionized plasma is the oldest kinetic problem of probe theory. It presents key difficulties in plasma simulation: disparate velocity scales, orbital motion, phase-space regions that no characteristic of the plasma reaches, a boundary set by a kinetic flux balance, and collisions that qualitatively change the answer. We use this problem to demonstrate the Plasma Adaptive Mesh and Algorithm Refinement (PAMAR) framework introduced in a companion paper. Electrons and ions have separate solvers on their own adaptive $(r,v,\mu)$ octrees, or on reduced phase spaces at the angular-moment level (Fokker-Planck and two-stream models), coupled through a radial Poisson field solver. Two exact references, a method of characteristics for the collisionless problem and integration along the orbits for elastic scattering, audit the solvers. We compute the current-voltage characteristic of the probe on both electron and ion branches, and the profiles of the potential and of the moments of both species agree with the exact solution. Far from the sphere, the potential follows the Coulomb law in neither limit: it falls as $r^{-2}$ without collisions and as $r^{-1}$ only beyond the ion mean free path. With elastic electron scattering, the kinetic solver follows the exact dependence of the collected current on the mean free path, from free flight toward diffusion, to 1 percent. Finally, we demonstrate the ion model selection cell by cell, using a fluid model coupled to the kinetic solver, with the interface set by the pressure anisotropy; with charge exchange, a sensor of ion trapping is also needed. According to exact solutions, the ion anisotropy extends to several probe radii, much farther than the electron loss cone.

summaries.en: The PAMAR framework simulates a spherical absorbing probe in weakly ionized plasma using adaptive (r,v,mu) octrees with separate electron and ion solvers coupled to a Poisson field solver, reproducing exact collisionless and elastic-scattering references, the current-voltage characteristic, and far-field potential scaling while enabling cell-by-cell ion model selection via pressure anisotropy and ion-trapping sensors.
summaries.zh: PAMAR框架利用自适应(r,v,μ)八叉树分别求解电子与离子并结合泊松场求解器，模拟弱电离等离子体中的球形吸收探针，复现了无碰撞与弹性散射的精确参考解、电流-电压特性及远场电势标度，并通过压力各向异性与离子捕获传感器实现逐单元的离子模型选择。
summaries.ja: PAMARフレームワークは、適応的(r,v,μ)オクトリー上で電子とイオンを別々に解きポアソン場ソルバーと結合することで弱電離プラズマ中の球形吸収プローブをシミュレーションし、無衝突および弾性散乱の厳密解、電流-電圧特性、遠方電位のスケーリングを再現するとともに、圧力異方性とイオントラッピングのセンサーによりセルごとのイオンモデル選択を可能にする。

title: Spectral integral method for reflection and transmission by one-dimensional periodic arrays of penetrable cylinders
abstract: The spectral integral method (SIM) is extended from a single cylinder to an infinite one-dimensional (1-D) periodic array (a grating) of identical, homogeneous, arbitrarily shaped smooth cylinders. The cylinders may be dielectric or metallic with complex electrical permittivity. Interactions among all members of the array are carried exactly by the 1-D quasi-periodic Green's function, Gp, in the exterior boundary integral equation, so only the boundary of one reference cylinder is discretized. Gp is written as the free-space Green's function plus a regular part that is infinitely differentiable on the reference cylinder whenever the cylinders do not touch. The regular part and its gradient are evaluated with Ewald's method. Floquet reflection and transmission amplitudes, as well as reflectance, transmittance, and absorptance, are obtained from the boundary data. For the analytic boundaries and numerical examples considered here, the SIM exhibits root-exponential convergence in N for glass and gold gratings, where N is the number of samples on the boundary, for both polarizations, at oblique incidence and with several diffraction orders. Several numerical examples are provided.

summaries.en: The spectral integral method is extended to infinite one-dimensional periodic gratings of identical, homogeneous, arbitrarily shaped penetrable cylinders, using a quasi-periodic Green's function evaluated by Ewald's method so that only one reference cylinder boundary is discretized, yielding root-exponential convergence in the number of boundary samples for glass and gold gratings at oblique incidence and both polarizations.
summaries.zh: 谱积分方法被扩展用于由相同、均匀、任意形状的可穿透圆柱构成的无限一维周期光栅，通过Ewald方法计算准周期格林函数从而只需离散一个参考圆柱的边界，对玻璃和金光栅在斜入射和两种偏振下均实现了关于边界采样数的根指数收敛。
summaries.ja: スペクトル積分法を、同一で均質かつ任意形状の透過性円柱からなる無限一次元周期格子へ拡張し、Ewald法で評価した準周期グリーン関数により参照円柱一つ分の境界のみを離散化することで、ガラスおよび金の格子について斜入射・両偏波で境界サンプル数に対する根指数的収束を示した。

title: Modular Programmable Photonics with Unitary Tiles
abstract: Programmable photonics provides a versatile platform for optical information processing, but extending programmable transformations to large numbers of optical modes remains challenging. We investigate a modular architecture composed of unitary tiles arranged in alternating and staggered columns. Each physical tile interlaces fixed multiport mixers with programmable phase shifts, confining individual mixing operations to small groups of modes while connecting them across a larger processor. We analyze the relationship between circuit depth, intertile connectivity, and attainable transformations, distinguishing ideal programmable tiles from their physical phase-stack implementations. Numerical target-fitting results show a transition in the reconstruction errors at $R = 2K$, where $K$ and $R$ are the number of tile rows and columns, respectively. This design ultimately aims to enable large and reliable port-count optical photonic processors.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes a modular programmable photonics architecture using alternating columns of unitary tiles that interleave fixed multiport mixers with programmable phase shifts, showing that reconstruction error transitions at R = 2K (K tile rows, R columns) and distinguishing ideal tiles from physical phase-stack implementations toward scalable, reliable many-port optical processors.
summaries.zh: 该论文分析了一种模块化可编程光子学架构，其采用交替排列的酉瓦片列，将固定多端口混频器与可编程相移交错结合，数值结果表明在 R = 2K（K 为瓦片行数、R 为列数）处重构误差出现转变，并区分了理想可编程瓦片与其物理相位堆叠实现，旨在实现大规模、可靠的多端口光学光子处理器。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、固定多ポート混合器とプログラマブル位相シフトを交互に配置したユニタリタイルの列を交互・千鳥状に並べるモジュール型プログラマブルフォトニクス構成を解析し、数値的なターゲットフィッティングにより R = 2K（K はタイル行数、R は列数）で再構成誤差に転移が現れることを示すとともに、理想的なプログラマブルタイルと物理的な位相スタック実装を区別し、大規模で信頼性の高い多ポート光フォトニックプロセッサの実現を目指す。

title: Universal Quantum Computation in a Wigner's Friend Framework
abstract: The Wigner's Friend thought experiment illustrates a core tension in quantum mechanics: an observer inside an isolated laboratory (the Friend) measures a definite outcome, while an external observer (Wigner) describes the laboratory as a coherent superposition. Here we show that this discrepancy, usually studied as a conflict between descriptions, has a direct computational consequence. We namely propose a protocol by which Wigner can turn the Friend's laboratory into a universal quantum computer, whereby the Friend is restricted to apply simple classical operations within the laboratory. We also experimentally implement a proof-of-principle demonstration of this protocol for single-qubit gates using single photons. By recasting the coherence between incompatible descriptions as a computational resource, we thus link the foundations of quantum measurement to quantum computation.

summaries.en: The paper shows that the Wigner's Friend discrepancy can be turned into a computational resource, with Wigner converting the Friend's laboratory into a universal quantum computer while the Friend performs only simple classical operations, demonstrated experimentally for single-qubit gates using single photons.
summaries.zh: 该论文表明，Wigner's Friend 悖论中的描述分歧可以转化为一种计算资源：Wigner 能把 Friend 的实验室变成通用量子计算机，而 Friend 只执行简单的经典操作，并用单光子实验演示了单量子比特门。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、ウィグナーの友人のパラドックスにおける記述の不一致を計算資源へと転換できることを示し、友人が単純な古典的操作のみを行う状況でウィグナーが友人の実験室を万能量子計算機に変えるプロトコルを提案し、単一光子による単一量子ビットゲートの原理実証実験を行った。

title: Control of Non-Markovianity via Channel Exceptional Points in a Driven-Dissipative Kerr-Cat Qubit
abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) in open quantum systems are conventionally defined at the Liouvillian level, making them representation-dependent and often requiring auxiliary degrees of freedom. We study EPs directly at the quantum-channel level in a driven-dissipative Kerr-cat qubit, in which dissipation drives bidirectional jumps between its two basis states. Interpolating two Markovian channels yields single EPs when the endpoints straddle a spectral-phase boundary and, remarkably, double EPs within the same phase. The interpolated EPs map out a Markovian--non-Markovian phase diagram: the parameter plane separates certified non-Markovian and Markovian domains, with domain boundaries switching the channel between the two characters. Three spectral criteria certify every domain. As the evolution time advances, the domains drift, split, and partially shrink, making the switching increasingly sensitive to parameters and time. This establishes a representation-independent paradigm for classifying and switching quantum memory effects, applicable to continuous-variable, discrete-variable, and hybrid systems.

summaries.en: By interpolating two Markovian quantum channels in a driven-dissipative Kerr-cat qubit, the authors identify single and double channel-level exceptional points, representation-independently mapping a Markovian–non-Markovian phase diagram whose certified domains drift, split, and shrink as evolution time advances.
summaries.zh: 通过在驱动耗散Kerr-cat量子比特中插值两个马尔可夫量子信道，作者识别出单重和双重信道级奇异点，并以不依赖表示的方式绘制出马尔可夫—非马尔可夫相图，其经三条谱判据认证的区域随演化时间推进而发生漂移、分裂和部分收缩。
summaries.ja: 駆動散逸型Kerr-cat量子ビットにおいて2つのマルコフ量子チャネルを補間することで、単一および二重のチャネルレベル例外点を同定し、表現非依存にマルコフ―非マルコフ相図を描出して、3つのスペクトル規準で認定された各領域が時間発展に伴いドリフト・分裂・部分的収縮することを示した。

title: Linear-optical nonlocality without postselection
abstract: Linear optics is one of the major platforms for quantum information processing and experimental tests of quantum foundations. This motivates a thorough exploration of its capabilities and limitations. In this paper we investigate the extent to which passive linear optics, when fed with single-photon Fock states and followed by postselection-free number-resolving measurements, can demonstrate nonlocality. These resources define BosonSampling, a computational model believed to have intermediate computational power, being neither classically simulable nor quantum universal. We prove that, when restricted to only two input photons, this system also has intermediate nonlocality capabilities, achieving a violation of the CHSH inequality no higher than $1+\sqrt{2}$. Although this value has appeared frequently in the literature as achievable, to our knowledge this is the first proof that it is maximal. We show that, as we increase the number of available photons, linear optics can produce violations arbitrarily close to Tsirelson's bound of $2\sqrt{2}$. Finally, we extend the analysis to tripartite nonlocality, leveraging well-known interferometric suppression laws to show how several tripartite inequalities can be violated in this setup beyond their bipartite bounds.

summaries.en: The paper proves that passive linear optics with single-photon inputs and postselection-free number-resolving measurements can demonstrate nonlocality, with two photons achieving a maximal CHSH violation of 1+√2, more photons approaching Tsirelson's bound, and tripartite inequalities being violated beyond their bipartite bounds via interferometric suppression laws.
summaries.zh: 该论文证明，输入单光子并采用无后选择光子数分辨测量的无源线性光学能够展示非定域性：两个光子时可达到CHSH不等式最大违背值1+√2，随着光子数增加违背可任意接近Tsirelson界，并借助干涉抑制定律在三方情形下超越双方界限违背若干三方不等式。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、単一光子入力とポストセレクション不要の光子数分解測定を用いた受動的線形光学が非局所性を実証でき、2光子ではCHSH不等式の最大違反1+√2を達成し、光子数を増やすとTsirelson限界に任意に近づき、干渉抑制則により三者の不等式が二部分界限を超えて破られることを示した。

title: Record-proof optical communication enabled by a quantum receiver with lossless optical decryption
abstract: We propose record-proof physical-layer encryption (PLE) based on quantum-optimal reception. Unlike conventional symmetric-key encryption algorithms, the proposed scheme prevents decryption of recorded signals even if the secret key is disclosed after transmission. Existing PLE schemes rely on practical limitations of the eavesdropper's receiver in pursuing record-proof security; ours instead exploits the noncommutativity of conjugate optical quadratures to give the legitimate receiver an intrinsic sensitivity advantage. A phase-controlled Kennedy receiver performs lossless optical decryption and near-optimal binary-state discrimination. We demonstrate record-proof security with a 3.0-dB channel-loss budget, showing that quantum receivers offer cryptographic functions beyond sensitivity enhancement.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a record-proof physical-layer encryption scheme based on a phase-controlled Kennedy quantum receiver that exploits the noncommutativity of conjugate optical quadratures to give the legitimate receiver an intrinsic sensitivity advantage, achieving lossless optical decryption and record-proof security with a 3.

summaries.ja: 本論文は、位相制御ケネディ量子受信機に基づく記録耐性物理層暗号化を提案し、共役な光直交位相間の非可換性を利用して正規受信者に本質的な感度優位性を与えることで、無損失光復号を実現し、3.

title: Quantum-Enhanced Passive and Active Radio-Frequency Photonic Imaging
abstract: Radio-frequency (RF) photonics enables broadband, phase-coherent sensing beyond the reach of purely electronic architectures, yet at a given optical carrier power its sensitivity is bounded by the standard quantum limit of the optical readout. Here, we experimentally demonstrate that this limit can be surpassed in both passive and active RF imaging modalities by encoding RF signals onto a bright phase-squeezed optical carrier and recovering them via balanced homodyne detection, while the RF front end, illumination, and image reconstruction remain classical. A unified measurement model shows that phase squeezing reduces the variance of the additive readout noise by a single factor $g$, yielding peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) gains of up to $2G$, where $G\equiv10\log_{10}(1/g)$: between $G$ and $2G$ for deterministic targets in active imaging when the classical noise of the echoes is negligible against the readout noise, and set by the ratio of scene noise to readout noise in passive imaging. We validate the model in an experiment in the 5--20 MHz band, in which synthesized RF scenes are replayed through a physical squeezed-light receiver. With 3 dB of squeezing, the PSNR improves by about 6 dB, close to $2G$, in the readout-noise-dominated regime of both modalities, and the model predicts the measured gains without free parameters. These results identify where squeezed-light readout benefits RF-photonic imaging: wherever the optical readout noise, rather than the scene or the RF front end, dominates the image error.

summaries.en: Experimentally, encoding RF signals onto a bright phase-squeezed optical carrier and detecting them with balanced homodyne readout surpasses the standard quantum limit in both passive and active RF photonic imaging, improving peak SNR by up to 2G (about 6 dB with 3 dB of squeezing) when optical readout noise dominates.
summaries.zh: 该研究通过将射频信号编码到明亮的相位压缩光载波上并用平衡零拍探测读取，在无源和有源射频光子成像中均突破了标准量子极限，在光读出噪声主导时峰值信噪比最高提升2G（3 dB压缩下约6 dB）。
summaries.ja: 明るい位相スクイーズド光キャリアにRF信号を符号化しバランスドホモダイン検出で読み出すことで、受動・能動の両RFフォトニックイメージングにおいて標準量子限界を超え、光読み出し雑音が支配的な領域でピークSNRを最大2G（3 dBのスクイージングで約6 dB）改善できることを実験的に示した。

title: Collective coupling of over 100 individually trapped atoms to a single cavity mode
abstract: Coupling optical tweezer arrays to high-finesse cavities provides a shared optical interface for neutral-atom registers. Scaling this interface to large tweezer arrays requires placing many traps within the coupling region of a single cavity mode while maintaining uniform trapping and site-resolved detection. Here we match a two-dimensional array of 192 optical tweezers to the coupling profile of a millimeter-scale Fabry-Perot cavity. To improve trap uniformity in the array generated by crossed acousto-optic deflectors, we combine optimization with optical feedback and atomic fluorescence feedback, achieving a mean cesium loading probability of approximately 58%. In each trial, fluorescence imaging determines whether each individual tweezer site is occupied, allowing the cavity transmission spectra to be grouped by atom number. The grouped spectra exhibit resolved normal-mode doublets, and the group with 120 imaged atoms yields an effective collective coupling of $G_{\mathrm{eff}}/(2\pi) = 21.30 \pm 0.23$ MHz. A model based on the calculated coupling profile and measured site loading probabilities predicts that the mean squared coupling per occupied site changes little between 97 and 120 atoms. The fitted collective coupling is therefore consistent with square-root scaling with atom number despite the spatial variation in single-atom coupling. These results provide an experimental basis for studying photon-mediated many-body dynamics and developing cavity-assisted readout and optical links between neutral-atom registers.

summaries.en: By matching a two-dimensional array of 192 optical tweezers to a millimeter-scale Fabry-Perot cavity mode and grouping cavity transmission spectra by fluorescence-imaged atom number, the authors achieved a collective coupling of Geff/(2π) = 21.
summaries.zh: 通过将192个光镊组成的二维阵列匹配到毫米级法布里-珀罗腔模，并按荧光成像确定的原子数对腔透射谱分组，作者在120个原子时实现了Geff/(2π) = 21.
summaries.ja: 192個の光ツイーザーからなる二次元アレイをミリメートルスケールのファブリ・ペロー共振器モードに整合させ、蛍光イメージングで決定した原子数ごとに共振器透過スペクトルを分類することで、120原子においてGeff/(2π) = 21.

title: Quantum geometric spectroscopy with Schrödinger cat states
abstract: We propose a spectroscopic approach that reads out the quantum geometry of matter from the quantum decoherence of Schrödinger-cat light, in the same way that optical absorption reads out the energy structure of matter. For a cat-state probe comprising a superposition of two coherent states, the interbranch coherence of the outgoing light encodes the overlap between the matter states driven by the two branches. We show that, when the electromagnetic fields of the two branches differ only slightly, cat-branch decoherence is quantified by dynamical quantum geometry, which characterizes infinitesimal displacements on the matter-state manifold. For frequency-selective kitten probes of equilibrium matter, we further establish a partition law for the quantum geometric tensor between light and matter, enabling optical readout of matter quantum metric and Berry curvature through, for example, the brightening of a stellar zero in the outgoing Husimi function. For nonequilibrium matter in a pure state, short-pulse cat probes also provide a time-resolved witness of multipartite entanglement through the transient quantum metric, which can be extracted from homodyne measurements of the outgoing light. By turning cat-state decoherence, conventionally regarded as a loss of quantum information, into a carrier of information about matter, this approach establishes a spectroscopic principle that directly probes quantum-state geometry and fluctuations alongside conventional response-based spectroscopy.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el); Optics (physics.optics)

summaries.en: The paper proposes a spectroscopic method in which the quantum decoherence of Schrödinger-cat light probes the quantum geometry of matter, enabling optical readout of the quantum metric and Berry curvature of equilibrium matter via a light-matter partition law for the quantum geometric tensor and providing a time-resolved witness of multipartite entanglement in nonequilibrium pure states through the transient quantum metric.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出一种光谱学方法，利用薛定谔猫态光的量子退相干来读取物质的量子几何，通过光与物质之间量子几何张量的分配定律实现平衡态物质量子度规和贝里曲率的光学读出，并借助瞬态量子度规对非平衡纯态中的多体纠缠提供时间分辨的见证。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、シュレーディンガー猫状態光の量子デコヒーレンスを用いて物質の量子幾何を読み出す分光法を提案し、光と物質の間の量子幾何テンソルの分配則により平衡物質の量子計量とBerry曲率の光学的読み出しを可能にするとともに、過渡的な量子計量を通じて非平衡純粋状態における多体エンタングルメントの時間分解証拠を与える。

title: Near-synchronous multiphoton quantum interference
abstract: Nonclassical multiphoton interference is an important resource for optical quantum information processing, and its output statistics depend on the distinguishability of the input photons. In this paper, using time delay as a tunable parameter, we theoretically analyze the interference behavior of independent pure-state single photons with identical Gaussian spectral envelopes under near-synchronous conditions. Using the immanant representation of the single-photon internal-state overlap matrix to express the weights of the exchange-symmetry components, we determine the leading asymptotic behavior and approximation error of each weight, and characterize the weight suppression laws when different groups of photons become synchronized on different scales. Given the local identity classes of the delay functions and the vanishing orders of pairwise delay differences, the vanishing orders of the weights of the exchange-symmetry components can be computed in polynomial time by integer minimum-cost flow. On this basis, we provide a network-independent total-variation error bound for the complete output photon-number distribution, establish a quantitative relationship among the photon spectral width, synchronization precision, and interference statistics deviation, and provide a quantitative basis for the analysis and approximation of near-synchronous multiphoton interference.

summaries.en: Using time delay to tune photon distinguishability, the authors derive immanant-based asymptotic weights for exchange-symmetry components of identical Gaussian single photons under near-synchronous conditions, compute their vanishing orders in polynomial time via integer minimum-cost flow, and give a network-independent total-variation error bound for the full output photon-number distribution.
summaries.zh: 本文以时间延迟为可调参数，利用单光子内态重叠矩阵的immanant表示，推导了近同步条件下具有相同高斯谱包络的独立纯态单光子的交换对称分量权重的渐近行为与消失阶，证明这些消失阶可通过整数最小费用流在多项式时间内计算，并给出了完整输出光子数分布的网络无关全变差误差界。
summaries.ja: 時間遅延を可変パラメータとして用い、同一のガウス型スペクトル包絡を持つ独立な純粋状態単一光子の近同期条件下での干渉を、単一光子内部状態重なり行列のイマナント表現により解析し、交換対称成分の重みの漸近的消失次数を整数最小費用流で多項式時間で計算できること、および出力光子数分布全体に対するネットワーク非依存の全変動誤差上界を示した。

title: Reversal of dynamical backaction and cooling below the quantum backaction limit in Floquet-driven multimode optomechanical resonators
abstract: Dynamical backaction describes how a driven cavity field responds with delay to mechanical motion, and can be used to cool that motion toward its quantum ground state or amplify it into self-oscillation. Control over this interaction underpins laser cooling, high-fidelity state preparation, quantum transduction, and phonon lasing. In conventional cavity optomechanics, both the sign and the magnitude of the optical damping are dictated by the laser detuning, and cooling is bounded by quantum backaction (QBA), the optomechanical analogue of the Doppler limit in cold atoms. We show, in theory and experiment, that dynamical backaction can be strongly enhanced in multimode optomechanical resonators driven by time-varying (Floquet) optical fields. A modulated drive couples a sideband-unresolved MHz mode to a sideband-resolved GHz mode through the shared cavity, replacing the QBA limit of the target mode by the occupancy of the auxiliary mode. Experimentally, we cool the MHz mode to $47 \pm 13$ phonons, about half its single-mode QBA limit and an order of magnitude below what single-tone backaction reaches at the same intracavity photon number. The character of the interaction can moreover be completely inverted at fixed laser detuning, turning cooling into amplification and vice versa, controlled solely by the modulation frequency. Floquet driving thus extends open-loop quantum control, which requires no measurement or feedback, to mechanical resonators outside the resolved-sideband regime.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall); Optics (physics.optics)

summaries.en: Floquet-driven multimode optomechanical resonators enable reversal of dynamical backaction and cooling of a sideband-unresolved MHz mode to 47 ± 13 phonons, roughly half its single-mode quantum backaction limit, by coupling it through the shared cavity to a sideband-resolved GHz mode whose occupancy sets the new limit.
summaries.zh: Floquet驱动的多模光机械谐振器能够逆转动力学反作用，并通过对共享腔将边带未分辨的MHz模式与边带分辨的GHz模式耦合（后者占据数设定新极限），把前者冷却至47 ± 13个声子，约为其单模量子反作用极限的一半。

title: Deterministic nonlinear domain engineering algorithm with variable sub-coherence-length domains
abstract: We present a new and improved deterministic algorithm that calculates the poling domains for the implementation of arbitrary phase-matching functions (PMF) in quasi-phase-matched nonlinear crystals for parametric down-conversion photon sources. In contrast to previous work, the algorithm presented here makes full use of the limits of the fabrication process, such as the minimum feature size and resolution of the lithographic process underpinning the poling procedure. This minimizes the tracking error to the target electric field and improves the accuracy in reaching the desired PMF. We give a tutorial on how to calculate the target function for arbitrary PMFs and run the algorithm. We also demonstrate the procedure on a relevant application in quantum sensing, where we use a quadratic phase on the PMF to implement a broadband photon spectrum while maintaining high nonlinearity across the crystal. The designed crystal is experimentally tested, and the result matches expectations.

summaries.en: The paper presents an improved deterministic algorithm for designing poling domains in quasi-phase-matched nonlinear crystals that exploits fabrication limits such as minimum feature size and lithographic resolution to minimize tracking error to the target electric field, and demonstrates it experimentally with a quadratic-phase PMF for broadband photon spectra in quantum sensing.

title: Quantum adiabatic and diabatic optimization: A Hilbert space engineering strategy with Rydberg arrays
abstract: Neutral-atom arrays provide a versatile platform for encoding combinatorial optimization problems with arbitrary graph connectivity [Nguyen et al., PRX Quantum 4, 010316 (2023)]. Although the dynamics of individual encoding gadgets has been studied [Bombieri et al., PRX Quantum 6, 020306 (2025)], understanding annealing bottlenecks in larger networks remains challenging. We investigate how engineering the Hilbert-space geometry controls quantum annealing in a family of blockaded-chain models motivated by these encodings. While boundary terms encode the target maximum independent set problem, the bulk geometry induces an auxiliary optimization problem associated with independent sets of cliques. Spectrally, the energetics of the quantum system can be approximated by physically derived clique weights. When the target problem and the auxiliary problems are consistent, the low-energy modes lie predominantly within the target subspace. This spectral structure motivates a diabatic annealing strategy that exploits target-compatible excited states, as tested on the diamond-chain graph family. These results provide a framework for predicting annealing bottlenecks, and demonstrate Hilbert-space engineering as a strategy for improving neutral-atom quantum optimization protocols.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph)

summaries.en: This study shows that engineering the Hilbert-space geometry of blockaded Rydberg-atom chains controls quantum annealing, with clique-derived spectral weights predicting bottlenecks and a diabatic strategy exploiting target-compatible excited states improving optimization when auxiliary and target problems are consistent.

title: Quantum Networks with Realistic Photonic Memories
abstract: Ensemble based photonic memories paired with photon pair sources are the essential ingredient for many quantum networking protocols. Most protocols and theoretical analyses focus on networks of identical nodes, however, realistic networks consist of nodes that may vary from device to device. We investigate a network of non-identical memories and develop mitigation strategies for the variation in performance. We find that by strategically distributing the memories among the nodes and individually adapting the emission probabilities based on the memory efficiency the effect of the variance on fidelity and duration can to a large extend be mitigated. Generally, our analysis shows the importance of accounting and compensating for device variations to avoid deteriorating the performance. Lastly, we also link our results to memories where efficiency decays as a function of storage duration. Here, we show that our approach provides a visible improvement for networks with non-identical and decaying memories.

summaries.en: This study analyzes quantum networks built from non-identical ensemble-based photonic memories and shows that strategically distributing memories among nodes and individually adapting emission probabilities to memory efficiency largely mitigates performance variance in fidelity and duration, with visible improvements also for memories whose efficiency decays with storage time.

title: Hybrid quantum learning for imbalanced blood-cell classification: domain adaptation and classifier design
abstract: Limited annotated data, class imbalance, and morphological similarity make white blood cell classification challenging. We benchmark hybrid variational quantum classifier heads against an affine baseline on 821 microscopy images across seven morphological classes. Using ImageNet-initialised ResNet34 backbones and repeated stratified five-fold cross-validation, we first compare direct transfer with intermediate adaptation on MLL23, a larger peripheral blood cell microscopy dataset. To guide the head comparison, we explore different encoding strategies, variational depth, and the number of independent circuit blocks. We then compare the classifier performance using the affine head and two hybrid heads across multiple random seeds, under a shared training and evaluation protocol. For this comparison, all backbones share the same MLL23-adapted initialisation. Intermediate adaptation increases mean macro-F1 across all four affine-head fine-tuning configurations. The largest gain occurs with a frozen backbone, where macro-F1 rises from $0.685$ to $0.786$, a relative improvement of approximately $14.7\%$. The shallow two-block hybrid head achieves a mean pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 of $0.865 \pm 0.010$, compared with $0.879 \pm 0.008$ for the affine head. The corresponding balanced accuracies are $0.886 \pm 0.008$ and $0.889 \pm 0.010$, respectively. In the architectural exploration, the two-block hybrid head achieves the highest macro-F1 and balanced accuracy among the evaluated hybrid configurations, while the effect of encoding varies across the considered metrics. Our results help guide the design and evaluation of hybrid classifier heads for imbalanced microscopy by linking architectural choices to overall performance and class-specific precision-recall trade-offs.

title: Information about Optic Nerve Head Biomechanics is Already Coded in Your Clinical Charts and Can be Used to Predict Glaucoma Progression
abstract: Glaucoma patients routinely undergo optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging and intraocular pressure (IOP) assessment as part of standard care. Because IOP typically differs across visits, it is possible to map visit-to-visit ONH strains by registering OCT volumes acquired under different IOPs. These strains reflect ONH elasticity and, over longer intervals, also capture growth and remodeling of the ONH. In this study, we evaluated whether such visit-to-visit ONH strain signatures could serve as predictors of glaucoma progression. We retrospectively analyzed 525 eyes from 430 glaucoma patients (238 fast and 287 slow progressors), defining fast progression by a visual field index slope of -1.5% per year or worse. 3D strain maps were derived from baseline and follow-up OCT scans using AI. Predictions using T=1 to T=4 follow-up visits were evaluated by five-fold cross-validation in a long-term cohort (T=1: 1.30 years; T=4: 5.26 years) and short-term testing (T=1: 0.46 years; T=4: 1.25 years). Overall, IOP differed between paired visits in 92% of cases. Long-term T=1 prediction achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.74 and accuracy of 0.72. A single short-term follow-up (T=1) yielded an AUC of 0.75 and accuracy of 0.71; four follow-ups yielded an AUC of 0.87 and accuracy of 0.82. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) identified neuroretinal rim compression and prelaminar elongation associated with fast progression, with substantial inter-eye variability. Overall, visit-to-visit ONH strains derived from routine OCT predicted glaucoma progression after a single follow-up visit at a mean interval of 0.46 years. These findings suggest that short-term OCT/IOP assessments could provide valuable insights into ONH biomechanics, identify eyes at risk of rapid progression, and reveal distinct strain signatures associated with disease progression.

title: Mutual Colormap Dependence: How Recoloring Biomedical Images Changes Vision-Language Model Answers
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are being built to answer questions about biomedical images, yet they never see the measured intensities, only the colors that a colormap has assigned to them. For questions about image content, the colormap should not change the answer. We call the extent to which it does Mutual Colormap Dependence (MCD), the mutual information between the colormap and a model's answer, which is zero exactly when every colormap yields the same answer distribution. Because VLMs sample their answers, we compare recoloring with a control that uses the same number of calls to ask again about the unchanged gray image, so that ordinary resampling is not mistaken for an effect of the colormap. We test GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Qwen3-VL-235B under six luminance-monotonic colormaps (gray, viridis, plasma, inferno, magma, and cividis) on 50 medical visual-question-answering items from 16 SLAKE images, 64 ChestX-ray14 chest radiographs, and 200 BBBC039 fluorescence-microscopy images for exact nucleus counting. Every prompt tells the model to ignore the colormap. Even so, with three answers per colormap on the chest radiographs, the answers of all four models depend on the colormap (all Holm-adjusted $p \leq 0.002$). For Claude, some colored map overturns the majority answer on 29 of the 64 radiographs, where resampling gray alone overturns about 4, and Qwen's accuracy falls from 0.54 under gray to between 0.32 and 0.41 under the colored maps, mostly because it abstains. With one answer per colormap, recoloring adds disagreement beyond repeated sampling in 5 of 12 model-panel cells under per-cell 95% intervals, and repeating the instruction to ignore color does not reliably reduce it. The colormap is therefore part of what a VLM sees, and it can change the answer.

summaries.en: Biomedical vision-language models exhibit Mutual Colormap Dependence, meaning their answers to image-content questions change with the luminance-monotonic colormap used to render the image even when instructed to ignore color, with effects exceeding ordinary resampling variability across GPT-5.

title: Over-the-Air Semantic Alignment via Dual Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces
abstract: Semantic communications enable task-oriented information exchange, but suffer from latent-space mismatch when transmitter and receiver employ heterogeneous machine learning models. Existing semantic alignment methods rely on digital processing, introducing computational and latency overhead. This paper proposes a dual stacked intelligent metasurfaces (dual-SIM) architecture that performs semantic alignment entirely in the wave domain. By jointly exploiting programmable metasurfaces at both ends of a link and the wireless channel, the proposed architecture realizes an end-to-end linear transformation between heterogeneous latent spaces. We show phase-only multilayer SIM can approximate both supervised linear aligners and zero-shot Parseval-frame equalizers. We investigate single-SIM, disjoint asymmetric and symmetric dual-SIM, and jointly optimized dual-SIM configurations, considering channel equalization and constructive channel exploitation. For joint design, we develop an alternating projected gradient algorithm with convergence guarantees to first-order stationary points. We further introduce a deep-unrolled network that unrolls gradient-based iterations to reduce computational cost of SIM reconfiguration under channel variations. Numerical results with heterogeneous vision transformer encoders show accurate semantic alignment from moderate to high signal-to-noise ratios. The joint and symmetric disjoint dual-SIM designs achieve the highest accuracy over compact channels, the joint design leads at shallow stack depths, and the advantage over single-SIM designs diminishes at equal depth.
subjects: Signal Processing (eess.SP) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG); Machine Learning (stat.ML)

summaries.en: The paper proposes a dual stacked intelligent metasurfaces architecture that performs over-the-air semantic alignment entirely in the wave domain, using phase-only programmable metasurfaces at both link ends to realize linear transformations between heterogeneous latent spaces, with a jointly optimized design via an alternating projected gradient algorithm and a deep-unrolled network for reduced reconfiguration cost.

title: Wideband Terahertz Pinching-Antenna Systems (PASS): Bandwidth Limits, Ergodic Rate, and Placement Optimization
abstract: Terahertz (THz) bands offer the vast bandwidth that sixth-generation (6G) networks demand, but their severe path loss makes bringing the radiator close to the user decisive. Pinching-antenna systems (PASS) do exactly this, turning path loss into a programmable parameter by sliding radiating points along a dielectric waveguide, which makes THz their native regime. That regime, however, is inherently wideband and the waveguide is dispersive, whereas every existing PASS analysis is single-frequency and assumes a non-dispersive guide. This paper develops the first wideband, dispersion-aware theory of PASS and uncovers a limitation intrinsic to the pinching mechanism. Because co-phasing by physical position equalizes path length only modulo a wavelength, a pinching array is inherently beam-squint limited, and we show its frequency response is a Dirichlet kernel with a closed-form coherence bandwidth and an irreducible dispersion floor that even true-time-delay (TTD) correction cannot remove. A single unifying law governs the behavior, in which array gain trades against both coherence bandwidth and spatial robustness through one invariant that TTD correction breaks, reaching the floor with far fewer delay elements than a conventional array. We further characterize the wideband ergodic rate under random user locations, show that molecular absorption acts as a deterministic taper that multiplies the squint, and derive a simple rule for the rate-optimal number of pinches. Finally, by exploiting the integer structure of co-phasing, we recast the non-convex placement problem as a mixed-integer program that can be solved exactly in polynomial time. Together, these results move PASS from the narrowband, dispersion-blind setting to the wideband, dispersive regime that THz operation actually requires.

summaries.en: This paper develops the first wideband, dispersion-aware theory of terahertz pinching-antenna systems, showing that position-based co-phasing yields a Dirichlet-kernel frequency response with a closed-form coherence bandwidth and an irreducible dispersion floor that even true-time-delay correction cannot fully remove, and it derives ergodic rate results and a polynomial-time exact mixed-integer placement optimization.
summaries.zh: 本文首次建立了太赫兹夹持天线系统（PASS）的宽带色散感知理论，表明基于物理位置的共相位会产生Dirichlet核频率响应，具有闭式相干带宽以及即使真实时延（TTD）校正也无法完全消除的不可约色散下限，并推导了遍历速率结果以及可在多项式时间内精确求解的混合整数放置优化方法。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、テラヘルツ・ピンチングアンテナシステム（PASS）に関する初の広帯域・分散考慮型理論を構築し、物理的位置に基づく同相化がディリクレ核の周波数応答を生み出して閉形式のコヒーレンス帯域幅と真の時間遅延（TTD）補正でも除去できない不可避な分散フロアを持つことを示すとともに、エルゴディックレートの解析と多項式時間で厳密に解ける混合整数配置最適化を導出した。

title: Miniaturized Low-Cost 3-D Printed High-Permittivity Dielectric Transmissive LP-to-CP Converter for L-Band Satellite Communications
abstract: A low-cost, miniaturized, additively manufactured transmissive linear-to-circular polarization converter for L-band air and space communication systems is presented. The proposed polarizer employs an in-house-fabricated high-permittivity dielectric medium, realized using a 3-D printed polylactic acid (PLA) enclosure filled with a TiO$_2$--water mixture. Variation in the effective permittivity is achieved by adjusting the mixture filling fraction. The selected 60\% filling fraction corresponds to an effective relative permittivity of 11.3 at 1 GHz. The high-permittivity loading enables miniaturization of the polarizer height and area by reducing the anisotropic dielectric unit-cell dimensions to $\boldsymbol{0.037\lambda_0 \times 0.037\lambda_0 \times 0.22\lambda_0}$. An additively manufactured polarizer with overall dimensions $\boldsymbol{0.83\lambda_0 \times 0.77\lambda_0 \times 0.22\lambda_0}$ is experimentally validated using a compact linearly polarized feed source. The measured results demonstrate LP-to-CP conversion, with a 3 dB axial ratio of 12\% and insertion loss of less than 0.6 dB. Radiation-pattern measurements at 1 GHz show LHCP-to-RHCP discrimination levels of 19 and 24 dB in the \textbf{\textit{xz}}- and \textbf{\textit{yz}}-planes, respectively. The proposed configuration combines miniaturization, LP-to-CP conversion, and low-cost additive manufacturing, making it promising for UAV-mounted and other size-constrained L-band satellite communication terminals.
